ROUTE_A_HYPERLIQUID_UBTC_SPOT_BTC_PERP.account_mode_notes: Unified Account shares a single USDC balance across spot and USDC-margined perps without Portfolio Margin, but does NOT cross-collateralize spot UBTC for BTC-PERP margin. Cash-funded V3 therefore avoids Portfolio Margin completely at the cost of ~40% idle/margin USDC.
ROUTE_A_HYPERLIQUID_UBTC_SPOT_BTC_PERP.label: Route A: Hyperliquid Same-Venue (UBTC/USDC Spot + BTC-PERP)
ROUTE_A_HYPERLIQUID_UBTC_SPOT_BTC_PERP.wrapper_risk_notes: UBTC ('Unit Bitcoin', isCanonical=false, evmContract=0x9fdb...463) is bridged/wrapped BTC via Unit Protocol, NOT native L1 BTC custody. Subject to bridge/custody depeg risk; observed UBTC mid ($61,415.50) traded at -15.67 bps discount vs HL BTC oracle ($61,511.90).

ROUTE_B_BINANCE_BTC_SPOT_BTC_PERP.account_mode_notes: Standard Spot + USD-M Futures sub-wallets require separate USDT balances (no Portfolio Margin required or available for small retail tiers). Geographic/KYC futures access is NOT verified.
ROUTE_B_BINANCE_BTC_SPOT_BTC_PERP.label: Route B: Binance Same-Venue (BTC/USDT Spot + BTC/USDT Perp)
ROUTE_B_BINANCE_BTC_SPOT_BTC_PERP.wrapper_risk_notes: Native exchange-custodied BTC spot and USDT-M perpetual on Binance. No wrapper depeg, but subject to CEX custody, KYC, and strict regional derivatives restrictions.

ROUTE_C_CROSS_VENUE_BINANCE_SPOT_HL_PERP.account_mode_notes: Requires pre-funded USDT on Binance Spot and separate pre-funded USDC on Hyperliquid Perp. Margin is strictly non-fungible across venues; emergency rebalance requires on-chain transfer.
ROUTE_C_CROSS_VENUE_BINANCE_SPOT_HL_PERP.label: Route C: Cross-Venue (Binance BTC/USDT Spot + Hyperliquid BTC-PERP)
ROUTE_C_CROSS_VENUE_BINANCE_SPOT_HL_PERP.wrapper_risk_notes: Avoids UBTC wrapper, but splits custody across two venues (Binance + Hyperliquid), introduces USDT/USDC FX basis, non-fungible margin, transfer latency, and asynchronous outage risk.
